subject.title: Docs landing page: stale brand hero, missing fourth quick-start card, fallback card icons

question: Should maintainers land the paired docs landing refresh with the docs-site lucide icon renderer after the linked PR's localized-asset compatibility concern is fixed?
rationale: The item has a protected maintainer label, depends on a same-repo implementation PR plus a separate docs-site renderer PR, and includes brand/visual direction that automation should not close or bypass.

options.title: Review and land paired PRs
options.body: Proceed with the OpenClaw docs refresh once the PR preserves or migrates localized hero asset references, and coordinate it with the docs-site lucide icon PR.

options.title: Narrow the OpenClaw PR first
options.body: Land only the hero/card/palette pieces that are compatibility-safe and keep icon rendering or asset deletion for follow-up.

options.title: Defer the brand refresh
options.body: Leave current docs unchanged until maintainers choose a different brand or docs-shell direction.

recommendation.title: Review and land paired PRs
recommendation.body: Proceed with the OpenClaw docs refresh once the PR preserves or migrates localized hero asset references, and coordinate it with the docs-site lucide icon PR.
